_comment: EVERY PATH IS THE APP, except the edge functions. app/routes.ts gives every
state a real URL over the History API, so a deep link, a shared URL and the
PWA start_url all arrive at a path with no file behind it.
The source MUST be a NAMED parameter. This read `/((?!api/).*)` until
2026-08-22 and the rule silently never matched: `source` is parsed as
path-to-regexp, not as a raw regex, and an UNNAMED group containing a
lookahead is not valid there. The symptom is total and was invisible
until the app was deployed - / served fine while /scan, /rules,
/settings and /viewer all returned 404 on both preview and production.
api/ is excluded explicitly rather than relying on the filesystem check
winning, so the intent is legible in the file rather than in Vercel's

headers.value: camera=(self), microphone=(), geolocation=(self), interest-cohort=(), payment=(), usb=()

default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src 'self' blob:; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https: wss:; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests
